name: POST /api/admin/accounts/:id/plan - Manual plan override
description:
Applies a comp/manual plan change. MUTATING, so the Authorization header carries the step-up token, NOT the login token. Delegates to SubscriptionService.createOrUpdateSubscription so the subscriptions row, users.plan and the current month's usage limit move together, then flags the row as a manual override. Returns a warning when the account has a live Stripe subscription, because a future webhook will overwrite the override.

The happy path raises the fixture account to 'solo'. Raising a limit cannot break other tests in the suite; lowering one could, so the downgrade path is left to the integration tests which own their own fixtures.

statusTransitions.any -> free: POST /api/admin/accounts/:id/plan with plan=free, or Stripe subscription cancellation
